meta.name: seo-unlighthouse
meta.description: Multi-page Lighthouse audit via the MIT-licensed Unlighthouse CLI. Free-tier alternative to running PageSpeed against every URL on a site — no API quota burn, runs locally.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对网站所有页面执行 Lighthouse 审计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量审计网站页面性能且不想消耗 API 配额。
copy.tagline_en: Run Lighthouse audits on every page of your site
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch audit page performance without API quota limits.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以对任意网站运行多页面 Lighthouse 审计，生成性能、可访问性、最佳实践和 SEO 的聚合分数，并输出 JSON 和 HTML 报告。
howto.when: 当你要求对某个网站进行 SEO 或性能审计时触发，例如使用“/seo unlighthouse <网址>”命令。

say.text: 对 example.com 运行 SEO 审计。
say.note: 触发移动端审计，最多 200 个路由。

say.text: 审计 example.com，使用桌面模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run a multi-page Lighthouse audit on any website, generating aggregate scores for performance, accessibility, best practices, and SEO, and output JSON and HTML reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to run an SEO or performance audit on a website, e.g., using the command '/seo unlighthouse <url>'.

say_en.note: Triggers mobile audit, up to 200 routes.

say_en.text: Audit example.com, limit 50 routes, save report to ./reports.
